How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the coffee maker performs well, making small amounts of coffee quickly and keeping it hot. The size is perfect for one person, and they appreciate its fast brewing time. The auto shut-off feature receives mixed feedback - while some customers like it, others report it stops working after 2 hours. The build quality is concerning, with customers describing it as flimsy, and there are issues with leakage from the reservoir.

    Inexpensive, but impressive. I purchased this unit after purchasing the Krups version (which is also nice). The Krups one did not have an auto-shutoff, but this one does. I sometimes forget to turn off the coffee and didn't want a possible fire risk with a dry pot situation. This Amazon Basics unit is no frills, does what it says, and has the auto-shutoff (yes, I tested it, and yes, it works). The build quality is cheap, but works as intended. For under $20, I can't complain. The carafe is a 5-sup, but fill up my Yeti mug perfectly with 2 full cups - which is the perfect amount of coffee for me. Brew time is relatively fast and carafe keeps it nice and hot. Recommend!

  • Bill54494
    4 out of 5 stars
    It works as advertised, but there are some things to know...
    Reviewed in the United States on July 14, 2026
    Size: 5-CupStyle: Non-Programmable - New Model
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I started using this coffee maker on July 7, 2026, and I'm writing this review on July 14, 2026. Here are some things a potential buyer should know.

    Things I like:

    1. It makes good coffee.

    2. It has a small footprint on my counter.

    3. The automatic turn-off of the warmer after 2 hours.

    4. The ease of use.

    5. The coffee is nice and hot, and the warmer keeps it that way for 2 hours.

    Something you should know: Believe the reviewers who note that the five cups it claims to make are very small cups. My coffee cup holds a comfortable 10 ounces (300ml). If I fill the water up just short of the 4-cup line on this machine, it makes two of my 10 ounce cups. That's perfect for me, but it might not be right for you, unless you do use tiny cups.

    There is nothing that I strongly dislike about this coffee maker, but there is one thing that I find mildly annoying: It is so light that it slides on my counter when I open the bin to put in water and coffee or when I press the on-off switch. These simple tasks become two-hand operations--one hand to steady the machine, the other to do the task at hand. (I might try to find a way to remedy this.)

    This machine is not perfect, but for the price and for what I need, I am very satisfied with the purchase. If I have more to add after I've put more miles on it, I will update this review.

  • Hackett Family
    5 out of 5 stars
    Excellent Value
    Reviewed in the United States on August 1, 2026
    Size: 5-CupStyle: Non-Programmable - New Model
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I normally don’t write extensive reviews, but this coffee maker deserves one. We were replacing our five year old Mr. Coffee because it made coffee not hotter than 160 to165 degrees.

    This coffee maker produces coffee at 175 to 180 degrees. Perfect temperature. While it feels a little flimsy, the positives far outweigh that.

    First, the carafe is straight sided. Easy cleaning compared the the Mr. Coffee carafe. Second, the water fill opening is massive. It would be difficult to spill the water going in. Third, it uses #2 paper cone filters. More intense coffee flavor. We are reserving the included permanent basket for emergency use.

    While we will probably never need the auto shutoff, it’s nice to know it is there.

    The only issue is that you have to learn to pour the coffee slowly when the carafe is full, otherwise it will drip.
